user.title: Mercedes Eco Coach
user.description: Enter your VIN. Leave the token blank to sign in via Mercedes in a desktop browser. Alternatively enter an existing access token.

callback.title: Complete Mercedes sign-in
callback.description: Copy the prefilled authorization URL into a desktop browser (not your phone) and sign in. When the browser cannot open the Eco Coach app, copy the COMPLETE `ecocoach://login/callback?...` URL from its address bar or history into the callback field within 10 minutes. Never share the callback URL.

data.authorization_url: Copy this URL and open it in your desktop browser

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Eco Coach token
reauth_confirm.description: Leave the token empty to start a new browser login, or enter a replacement bearer token.

error.invalid_auth: Mercedes rejected the authorization, or the callback was invalid or expired. Start a new login if needed.
error.cannot_connect: The Mercedes login or Eco Coach statistics server could not be reached.
error.invalid_response: The login or statistics server returned an unsupported response.
